whatsappMessage:
Hi Dr. Vivek,

I noticed your clinic DENTAL POINT has an incredible 4.9★ rating with 160+ reviews on Arya Kumar Road in Patna, but your online presence lacks a direct mobile appointment booking system for patients.

Maine aapke clinic ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp appointment booking, painless RCT/crown procedures showcase, aur patient reviews integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/dentalpoint

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Dr. Vivek, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke dental clinic (DENTAL POINT) ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? Great! We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp patient booking and a showcase of your painless root canal treatments in Machhua Toli, Patna. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko design direction pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact services, actual photos aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
